activities.title: Match the food with the meal.
Listen. Maya explains her pancake breakfast. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Diego: Maya, what did you have for breakfast? … Maya: Pancakes! I made them myself, like a science experiment. … Diego: How do you make them? … Maya: Easy. You need flour, two eggs and a cup of milk. … Diego: No sugar? … Maya: A little. And a small spoon of salt — that's the secret! … Diego: What do you put on top? … Maya: Honey. Sometimes strawberry jam. … Diego: How many pancakes did you eat today? … Maya: Six! My stomach was very happy.
